capabilities: Organize chapters and sections in a drag-reorderable book spine view
Style book chapters with manuscript typography, drop caps, and TK highlighting
Capture and reuse text snippets in a per-book scratchpad
Insert outside notes as blockquote citations with APA-style metadata
Compile the book spine into a single Markdown manuscript export
extras: Export is Markdown-only; the README notes EPUB, DOCX, LaTeX, and HTML export could build on the existing compiler later. Syncing across devices requires book.json, so Obsidian Sync must be set to sync all file types.
problem: Obsidian has no dedicated way to structure and assemble long-form manuscripts from separate Markdown files into ordered books.

relations.evidence: check Obsidian Sync's file type settings and enable syncing for all file types

summary: Book-writing environment that organizes Markdown chapters into books with a spine view, manuscript styling, scratchpad, research citations, and Markdown export.
